title: Coral Beer and Madeira Soft Drinks: What Locals Drink Besides Poncha
description: Coral beer, Brisa Maracujá and more: what locals drink in Madeira besides poncha and wine, and where to try each one. A simple guide for lunches by the sea.
heroAlt: A cold drink on a table aboard a private boat in Madeira
keywords: drinks on a boat trip Madeira

images.prompt: A cold glass of passion fruit soda with ice and a bottle of local lager on a wooden table aboard a small white private motorboat, Funchal coast and green cliffs softly blurred behind, bright afternoon light.
images.alt: Cold drinks on a table aboard a small boat off the Madeira coast

images.prompt: A busy sunny terrace café in Funchal old town with a waiter placing a tall draft beer and a yellow fizzy drink on a table, painted doors and cobbled street in the background.
images.alt: A café terrace in Funchal old town with cold drinks on the table
